verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ׀ עַל־ י֬וֹנַת אֵ֣לֶם רְ֭חֹקִים לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בֶּֽאֱחֹ֨ז אֹת֖וֹ פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים בְּגַֽת׃ חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱ֭לֹהִים כִּֽי־ שְׁאָפַ֣נִי אֱנ֑וֹשׁ כָּל־ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם לֹחֵ֥ם יִלְחָצֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- yō·w·naṯ ’ê·lem rə·ḥō·qîm lə·ḏā·wiḏ miḵ·tām be·’ĕ·ḥōz ’ō·ṯōw p̄ə·liš·tîm bə·ḡaṯ ḥān·nê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî- šə·’ā·p̄a·nî ’ĕ·nō·wōš kāl- hay·yō·wm lō·ḥêm yil·ḥā·ṣê·nî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of A Dove on Distant Oaks A Miktam of David when the Philistines seized him in Gath Be merciful to me O God for men are hounding me all day they press their attack

verses.original: שָׁאֲפ֣וּ שׁ֭וֹרְרַי כָּל־ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּֽי־ רַבִּ֨ים לֹחֲמִ֖ים לִ֣י מָרֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ă·p̄ū šô·rə·rai kāl- hay·yō·wm kî- rab·bîm lō·ḥă·mîm lî mā·rō·wm
verses.literal: My enemies pursue me all day long for many proudly assail me
When I am afraid I put my trust in You

verses.original: בֵּאלֹהִים֮ אֲהַלֵּ֪ל דְּבָ֫ר֥וֹ בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־ יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בָשָׂ֣ר לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lō·hîm ’ă·hal·lêl də·ḇā·rōw bê·lō·hîm bā·ṭaḥ·tî lō ’î·rā mah- ya·‘ă·śeh ḇā·śār lî
verses.literal: In God whose word I praise in God I trust I will not be afraid What can man do to me

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם דְּבָרַ֣י יְעַצֵּ֑בוּ עָלַ֖י כָּל־ מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֣ם לָרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hay·yō·wm də·ḇā·ray yə·‘aṣ·ṣê·ḇū ‘ā·lay kāl- maḥ·šə·ḇō·ṯām lā·rā‘
verses.literal: All day long . . . they twist my words all their thoughts are on my demise

verses.original: יָג֤וּרוּ׀ יַצְפִּינוּ הֵ֭מָּה עֲקֵבַ֣י יִשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר קִוּ֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḡū·rū yaṣ·pī·nū hêm·māh ‘ă·qê·ḇay yiš·mō·rū ka·’ă·šer qiw·wū nap̄·šî
verses.literal: They conspire they lurk they watch my steps while they wait to take my life

verses.original: עַל־ אָ֥וֶן פַּלֶּט־ לָ֑מוֹ בְּ֝אַ֗ף עַמִּ֤ים׀ הוֹרֵ֬ד אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.literal: In spite of such sin will they escape In Your anger O God cast down the nations

verses.original: נֹדִי֮ סָפַ֪רְתָּ֫ה אָ֥תָּה שִׂ֣ימָה דִמְעָתִ֣י בְנֹאדֶ֑ךָ הֲ֝לֹ֗א בְּסִפְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: nō·ḏî sā·p̄ar·tāh ’āt·tāh śî·māh ḏim·‘ā·ṯî ḇə·nō·ḏe·ḵā hă·lō bə·sip̄·rā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: You have taken account of my wanderings Put my tears in Your bottle are they not in Your book

verses.original: אָ֥֨ז יָ֘שׁ֤וּבוּ אוֹיְבַ֣י אָ֭חוֹר בְּי֣וֹם אֶקְרָ֑א זֶה־ יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yā·šū·ḇū ’ō·wy·ḇay ’ā·ḥō·wr bə·yō·wm ’eq·rā zeh- yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm lî
verses.literal: Then my enemies will retreat . . . on the day I cry for help By this I will know that God is on my side

verses.original: בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר בַּ֝יהוָ֗ה אֲהַלֵּ֥ל דָּבָֽר׃
verses.literal: In God whose word I praise in the LORD whose word I praise

verses.original: בֵּֽאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־ יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אָדָ֣ם לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lō·hîm bā·ṭaḥ·tî lō ’î·rā mah- ya·‘ă·śeh ’ā·ḏām lî
verses.literal: in God I trust I will not be afraid What can man do to me

verses.original: עָלַ֣י אֱלֹהִ֣ים נְדָרֶ֑יךָ אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם תּוֹדֹ֣ת לָֽךְ׃
verses.literal: Your vows are upon me O God I will render thank offerings to You

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִצַּ֪לְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֡י מִמָּוֶת֮ הֲלֹ֥א רַגְלַ֗י מִ֫דֶּ֥חִי לְ֭הִֽתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝א֗וֹר הַֽחַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî hiṣ·ṣal·tā nap̄·šî mim·mā·weṯ hă·lō raḡ·lay mid·de·ḥî lə·hiṯ·hal·lêḵ lip̄·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·’ō·wr ha·ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: For You have delivered my soul from death . . . and my feet from stumbling that I may walk before God in the light of life
